scripts.validate: uv run scripts/render.py --check && uv run scripts/plan.py validate && for d in applications/*/overlays/*/*/; do [ -f "$d/kustomization.yaml" ] || continue; echo "kustomize build $d"; kustomize build "$d" > /dev/null || exit 1; done; for f in applications/*/applicationset.yaml bootstrap/*.yaml; do kubeconform -strict -ignore-missing-schemas -schema-location default -schema-location 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datreeio/CRDs-catalog/main/{{.Group}}/{{.ResourceKind}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json' -summary "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test-fast: uv run scripts/render.py --check && uv run scripts/plan.py validate
